what_it_does: looks up each requested news id in a Vespa result and returns its relevance in request order

decisions.why: feed_iterable creates a worker pool and connections for every 32-document batch and blocks the next batch; hoisting is out of the batch loop

decisions.label: b
decisions.why: each JPEG is written then read back and decoded again; encoding into BytesIO gives the pixels of the lossy JPEG without disk, but the original embeds from the re-decoded JPEG, so a BytesIO round trip keeps those values

what_it_does: embeds a query and POSTs a binary-plus-float query to Vespa

decisions.label: a
decisions.why: `embedding.astype(np.float32)` copies an already-float32 array and `binary_q.astype(int)` widens before tolist

what_it_does: evaluates ranking on the Shopping Queries dataset against Vespa

decisions.label: a
decisions.why: read_parquet loads every column and row, then three boolean filters each copy the frame; columns= and one combined mask read less

decisions.label: b
decisions.why: the recall strings feed a groupby whose keys also come from qrels; restricting earlier needs the qrels join moved, a rewrite of the unit's order

decisions.label: c
decisions.why: `groupby(...).apply(lambda group: dict(zip(...)))` runs a Python lambda per query group

what_it_does: scores one query's hits and writes lines

decisions.label: a
decisions.why: args.trec_format is tested per hit though it does not change in the loop

what_it_does: formats a query template

decisions.label: a
decisions.why: a public one-line wrapper over str.format called once per templated field; the Looks-like-it near miss for C2.S1 applies and the frame is small against an HTTP request

what_it_does: maps NaN to None

decisions.label: a
decisions.why: np.isnan on a Python scalar goes through ufunc dispatch; `math.isnan` or `x != x` is cheaper for scalars; the function only sees scalars from itertuples, but arrays would break the repair so I accept pending a read of the caller

what_it_does: tokenises a query and prints its token ids as floats

decisions.label: a
decisions.why: runs once per CLI call; the saving is below anything a measurement can see

what_it_does: walks a dotted path through nested JSON

decisions.label: a
decisions.why: linear recursion with one frame per path segment; a loop over the split path does the same walk; semantics when a key is missing (None) are kept

what_it_does: walks a dotted path through nested JSON

decisions.label: a
decisions.why: same linear recursion as the sibling

what_it_does: maps a news id to its index through lookup_index

decisions.label: a
decisions.why: pure delegation to lookup_index with a fixed map, called once per impression item while loading; the call site in read_data can call lookup_index directly, but the method is public to the class so only a call-site inlining is allowed; sole callers are find_labels and read_news

what_it_does: maps a user id to its index through lookup_index

decisions.label: a
decisions.why: called once per impression, not per item; the frame is not hot enough to report

what_it_does: appends new entity ids to a list

decisions.label: a
decisions.why: the list holds at most a handful of ids per article, so a linear scan is the cheapest; a set would need the order kept as well

what_it_does: converts one Amazon record to a Vespa document

decisions.label: a
decisions.why: `fields['categories_text'] +=` grows a string through a subscript, so each concatenation copies it; collect parts and join, same text (no separator is inserted, the original joins category blocks without one)

what_it_does: reports whether any of three review fields contains U+001A

decisions.label: a
decisions.why: three if-return True branches then return False; `return ... or ... or ...` returns a bool already (the `in` tests are bool)

what_it_does: adds docid, qid and relevance to each hit's rank features

decisions.label: a
decisions.why: h['fields'] resolved four times per hit and three update calls; one local and one update call give the same dict contents

what_it_does: builds nearestNeighbor query strings from binary embeddings

decisions.label: a
decisions.why: range(len()) indexing over a small fixed number of query tokens; not a measurable cost
